description: This file contains PHP functions for handling JSON responses related to workflow components in vtiger CRM, including fetching module fields, functions, dependent modules, and owner lists.

methods.name: vtJsonFields
methods.description: Fetches module fields for a given module name and outputs as JSON.

methods.name: vtJsonFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves available expression functions and outputs as JSON.

methods.name: vtJsonDependentModules
methods.description: Determines dependent modules based on field references and outputs as JSON.

methods.name: vtJsonOwnersList
methods.description: Generates a list of owners (users and groups) and outputs as JSON.
